links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of physicians with MACD-human collaboration versus physician-only diagnosis on text vignettes
links.effect: MACD-human workflow yielded an 18.3-percentage-point improvement over physician-only diagnosis on text-only vignettes.
links.quote: Furthermore, the MACD-human workflow yields an 18.3-percentage-point improvement over physician-only diagnosis on text-only vignettes, demonstrating the synergistic potential of human-AI collaboration.
